quests.instruction: What is the action word for using good reasons to help someone agree with your idea?
quests.question: Convince
quests.hint: Think about explaining good reasons so a friend agrees to play your favorite game.
quests.explanation: Convince means to use good reasons so someone agrees with you. We convince a friend to try a new game!
quests.funFact: Sharing clear, honest reasons is the best way to convince someone kindly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for offering to help without being asked?
quests.question: Volunteer
quests.hint: Think about raising your hand right away to help clean up the classroom.
quests.explanation: Volunteer means to offer to help without being asked. We volunteer to help clean up our classroom!
quests.funFact: Volunteering to help others is a wonderful way to show kindness!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for helping and encouraging someone through something hard?
quests.question: Support
quests.hint: Think about cheering on a friend who feels nervous before a big test.
quests.explanation: Support means to help and encourage someone. We support our friends when they feel nervous!
quests.funFact: Knowing that someone supports you can make a hard day feel much easier!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for clapping your hands to show you enjoyed a performance?
quests.question: Applaud
quests.hint: Think about clapping loudly after a wonderful show ends.
quests.explanation: Applaud means to clap to show you enjoyed something. We applaud after a wonderful performance!
quests.funFact: A big round of applause can make performers feel proud and happy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for raising your hand to your forehead to show respect?
quests.question: Salute
quests.hint: Think about the special hand movement soldiers make to show respect.
quests.explanation: Salute means to raise your hand to your forehead to show respect. Soldiers salute their leaders!
quests.funFact: A salute is a special way that people in uniform show respect to each other!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for repeating the same happy words together in rhythm?
quests.question: Chant
quests.hint: Think about a crowd repeating the same cheer again and again at a game.
quests.explanation: Chant means to repeat the same words together in rhythm. Fans chant cheers at a big game!
quests.funFact: Chanting together in a crowd can feel like one big, exciting team!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for speaking words quickly in rhythm to a beat?
quests.question: Rap
quests.hint: Think about saying rhyming words quickly to a fun, bouncy beat.
quests.explanation: Rap means to speak words quickly in rhythm to a beat. We rap along to a fun, catchy song!
quests.funFact: Rapping uses clever rhymes and a steady beat to tell a story or share an idea!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for singing with your voice quickly switching high and low?
quests.question: Yodel
quests.hint: Think about a bouncy song sung high in the mountains, jumping between high and low notes.
quests.explanation: Yodel means to sing with your voice switching quickly between high and low. People yodel in the mountains!
quests.funFact: Yodeling began long ago as a fun way for mountain herders to call to each other!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using your hands to guide a group of musicians as they play?
quests.question: Conduct
quests.hint: Think about waving a small stick to show a band exactly when to play.
quests.explanation: Conduct means to guide musicians as they play, often with a small stick. A conductor leads the whole orchestra!
quests.funFact: A conductor's hand movements tell every musician exactly when and how loudly to play!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using numbers to figure out an answer?
quests.question: Calculate
quests.hint: Think about adding up numbers carefully to find the total.
quests.explanation: Calculate means to use numbers to figure out an answer. We calculate how many apples we have in total!
quests.funFact: Calculators can help us calculate big numbers super quickly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making a smart guess about an amount without counting exactly?
quests.question: Estimate
quests.hint: Think about looking at a jar of candy and guessing about how many pieces are inside.
quests.explanation: Estimate means to make a smart guess about an amount. We estimate how many candies are in a jar!
quests.funFact: A good estimate uses clues to make a smart guess, even without counting exactly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for saying what you think will happen before it happens?
quests.question: Predict
quests.hint: Think about guessing what will happen next in an exciting story.
quests.explanation: Predict means to say what you think will happen before it does. We predict what happens next in a story!
quests.funFact: Weather forecasters use science to help predict what the weather will be like!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looking back over something to check it or remember it?
quests.question: Review
quests.hint: Think about looking back over your spelling words before a test.
quests.explanation: Review means to look back over something to check or remember it. We review our notes before a test!
quests.funFact: Reviewing what you learned helps the information stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for looking at something to make sure it is correct?
quests.question: Check
quests.hint: Think about looking over your homework to make sure every answer is right.
quests.explanation: Check means to look at something to make sure it is correct. We check our homework before turning it in!
quests.funFact: Checking your work carefully can help you catch small mistakes!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for trying something out to see how well it works?
quests.question: Test
quests.hint: Think about trying out a new toy to see if it really works.
quests.explanation: Test means to try something out to see how it works. We test a new toy to see if it works well!
quests.funFact: Scientists test their ideas again and again to see if they are correct!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for finding the answer to a tricky problem or puzzle?
quests.question: Solve
quests.hint: Think about figuring out how the last few puzzle pieces fit together.
quests.explanation: Solve means to find the answer to a problem. We solve a tricky puzzle piece by piece!
quests.funFact: Solving a hard puzzle feels extra rewarding after all your hard work!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for finding two things that are the same or go together?
quests.question: Match
quests.hint: Think about finding two socks that look exactly the same.
quests.explanation: Match means to find two things that are the same or go together. We match pairs of socks!
quests.funFact: Matching games are a fun way to practice noticing small details!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for writing a word on something to say what it is?
quests.question: Label
quests.hint: Think about writing your name on your lunchbox so everyone knows it's yours.
quests.explanation: Label means to write a word on something to say what it is. We label our lunchboxes with our names!
quests.funFact: Labeling your things clearly helps you find and keep track of them!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for marking important words with a bright colored pen?
quests.question: Highlight
quests.hint: Think about coloring over the most important sentence in your notes with a bright pen.
quests.explanation: Highlight means to mark important words with bright color. We highlight the important parts of our notes!
quests.funFact: Highlighting key words can help the most important ideas stand out clearly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for drawing a line beneath important words?
quests.question: Underline
quests.hint: Think about drawing a straight line under the most important word in a sentence.
quests.explanation: Underline means to draw a line beneath important words. We underline the main idea in a sentence!
quests.funFact: Underlining key words helps you quickly spot them again later!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for drawing a round shape around the correct answer?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think about drawing a loop around the right answer on a worksheet.
quests.explanation: Circle means to draw a round shape around something. We circle the correct answer on a worksheet!
quests.funFact: Circling an answer clearly shows exactly which one you have chosen!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making something look exactly like another thing?
quests.question: Copy
quests.hint: Think about writing a word on your paper exactly the way it looks on the board.
quests.explanation: Copy means to make something look exactly like another thing. We copy words from the board into our notebook!
quests.funFact: Copying neatly and carefully helps you practice your best handwriting!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using glue to stick paper onto another surface?
quests.question: Paste
quests.hint: Think about using sticky glue to attach a picture onto your project.
quests.explanation: Paste means to use glue to stick paper onto a surface. We paste pictures onto our art projects!
quests.funFact: Paste is a thick, sticky glue that works especially well on paper!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for writing letters that do not connect, one by one?
quests.question: Print
quests.hint: Think about writing each letter of your name separately instead of joining them.
quests.explanation: Print means to write letters that do not connect together. We print our letters neatly before learning cursive!
quests.funFact: Printing clearly, letter by letter, helps others read your writing easily!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for pressing keys on a keyboard to write words?
quests.question: Type
quests.hint: Think about pressing letter keys one at a time to write a message.
quests.explanation: Type means to press keys on a keyboard to write. We type letters and words on a keyboard!
quests.funFact: Typing quickly and accurately takes lots of steady practice!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for writing a first, rough try of a story before making it better?
quests.question: Draft
quests.hint: Think about writing your very first try at a story, knowing you can fix it later.
quests.explanation: Draft means to write a first, rough try of something. We draft a story before we make it neat and final!
quests.funFact: Even great authors write many drafts before their story feels just right!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for fixing mistakes and making writing better?
quests.question: Edit
quests.hint: Think about going back through your story to fix spelling mistakes.
quests.explanation: Edit means to fix mistakes and make writing better. We edit our story to fix spelling mistakes!
quests.funFact: Editing your work carefully helps your final story shine!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for sharing finished writing so others can read it?
quests.question: Publish
quests.hint: Think about putting your finished story up on the class wall for everyone to read.
quests.explanation: Publish means to share finished writing so others can read it. We publish our stories on the class wall!
quests.funFact: When a story is published, it means it is finally ready for readers to enjoy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for drawing pictures to go along with a story?
quests.question: Illustrate
quests.hint: Think about drawing colorful pictures to match the words in your story.
quests.explanation: Illustrate means to draw pictures for a story. We illustrate our stories with colorful pictures!
quests.funFact: Illustrations help readers picture exactly what is happening in a story!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for using a camera to take a picture of something?
quests.question: Photograph
quests.hint: Think about pointing a camera at your family and clicking a button.
quests.explanation: Photograph means to use a camera to take a picture. We photograph our family on special days!
quests.funFact: A photograph can help you remember a special happy moment forever!
